proof_attempt_summary: The run derived an exact simultaneously attainable finite-grid survival set, triangular transport and min-cut certificates, an all-direction support formula, and the sharp RMST equality/failure boundary. Mathematical, decision, and citation review all passed after eight primary-source attestations; the result remained sound at subfield tier. The field claim collapsed because the censor reference is fixed and generally unidentified, while calibration, inference under estimated or misspecified references, and applied validation require a new contribution or re-anchor.
tldr: The paper identifies the simultaneously attainable finite-grid survival-contrast set under separate likelihood-ratio budgets for hidden treatment selection and prognosis-dependent censoring. It gives constructive common-prognosis gluing, triangular min-cut membership certificates, and an all-direction support formula. Pointwise survival composes exactly on every grid. For unit-grid RMST, optimizer-first sensitivity is exact whenever \(K\le2\), \(\Gamma_A=1\), or \(\Gamma_C=1\); strict failures occur on relatively open positive families only when \(K\ge3\) and both budgets are nontrivial. On the finite-grid population class of Baitairian et al., which is exactly the \(\Gamma_C=1\) slice after discretization, the whole-set theorem upgrades separate scalar population bounds to one simultaneously attainable survival-vector set. The genuinely new interaction and transport phenomena arise under dependent censoring with \(\Gamma_C>1\), at fixed grid and fixed declared censor reference.
gap: Current survival marginal-sensitivity papers bound treatment confounding while retaining independent or conditionally independent censoring; fixed-copula work chooses an equality-restricted dependence model, and proximal work adds proxies and completeness for point identification. The audited finite-grid relations show overlap in the one-period treatment box and independence submodel but non-equivalence at the latent censoring stage. None of these inspected classes establishes the simultaneously attainable survival-vector set under the two declared boxes or the exact pointwise-versus-RMST boundary.
